                except asyncio.TimeoutError:

        self.metrics = {'pfc_pause': 0, 'rdma_tx': MIB, 'rdma_rx': MIB}

I1: `spare = capacity − resident − reserved`, `spare ≥ 0`. Proof: reserve checks under lock; release only increases. Eviction only increases. So spare never negative.

I2: `resident = Σ size(entry)`. Proof: insert adds, evict subtracts, both under lock.

I3: RAM valid only if `ram[k].version == disk[k].version`. Proof: put writes disk then invalidates ram; get checks version. No stale shadow.

I4: epoch monotonic. Proof: only advance increments, under lock. No ABA.

I5: no lock held across wait. Proof: every wait is inside a condition's `async with`, which releases; every lock acquisition is `async with` scoped to a non-waiting block. No hold-and-wait → no deadlock.

I6: crash safety. On crash, reserved lost. Recovery: `resident = Σ`, `reserved = 0`, `spare = capacity − resident`. I1 holds after recovery.

I7: retry safety. Retry re-captures epoch; if epoch changed, re-runs. Since epoch monotonic, retry never sees older epoch. No stale read.

I8: idempotence. put is idempotent. reserve is not — retry must release before retrying. So reserve/release paired.
